evidence_items.summary: MR-Bench-H 900 human-validated clips in which a shortcut channel suggests the wrong sentiment. MR-Bench-H is the human-validated part of MR-Bench, introduced in Words Speak Louder? Exploring the Language Shortcut of LLM-Driven Incomplete Multimodal Learning.
